messages:
Aisha Patel: Quick update — org change effective Mon 2026-06-02: Evan Carter is moving into Head of Strategy & Developer Experience. Huge congrats! :tada: Please welcome him in #general later this week.

Marta Ruiz: Amazing, congrats Evan! :raised_hands:

Evan Carter: Really appreciate it. Honored. I'll be focusing on long-term serving strategy, cross-cutting DX improvements, and enterprise alignment. Planning a 30m AMA next Tue 10:00am PT — calendar invite coming.

Jonah Lee: FYI I'll be stepping into Evan's Senior Product Lead role for Serving Runtime. Happy to keep momentum on the roadmap: vnext batching, cache TTLs, and rollout tooling.

Aisha Patel: Headcount note: we'll open a backfill req for Jonah's previous PM scope (REQ-9872). Recruiting will prioritize internal transfers + partner postings. ETA to post: today. Budget approved for immediate hire.

people-ops-bot: New job req created: REQ-9872 — Senior Product Manager, Serving Runtime (link: https://jobs.redwood.ai/REQ-9872)

Lina Gomez (Recruiter): Tagged the role as priority and pinged the sourcing partners (Hacker News, GC, PRI hires). Will share scorecard and ideal candidate profile shortly.

Marta Ruiz: Hiring timeline estimate: 3–5 weeks to first on-site loop if we get good resumes. Recommend internal kickoff with PM, Eng Mgr, and EngOps for alignment.

Evan Carter: Quick org sketch I'm proposing (very high level):
```
Head of Strategy & DevEx — Evan Carter
  ├─ Serving Runtime PMs
  │   ├─ Jonah Lee (Product Lead)
  │   └─ Open: Senior PM (REQ-9872)
  ├─ Developer Experience (Docs, SDKs)
  └─ Cross-team strategy (SLA, cost/latency playbooks)
```

Aisha Patel: Action items:
- Lina: post REQ-9872 & share scorecard (today)
- Jonah: 1:1 with Eng Mgrs to handoff roadmap (this week)
- Evan: Host AMA + share 90-day priorities (next Tue)

Jonah Lee: I'll put together a 1-pager handoff and tag relevant RFCs. Thanks all.

Marta Ruiz: Welcome aboard Evan and congrats Jonah on the new role! :party_parrot:

Evan Carter: Thanks everyone — excited to get started. Ping me any time with questions or blockers. :rocket:
